issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks across multiple workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were being enrolled in multiple workflows simultaneously, causing HAs and TCs to receive duplicate tasks. The root cause was a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. HubSpot support was engaged and resolved the issue.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or dismiss the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow missing re-enrollment criteria, failing to trigger tasks after deal stage flip
issues.desc: When a deal was flipped from Offer Accepted back to a prior stage and then back to Offer Accepted again, the workflow tasks did not re-trigger to collect closing information. The root cause was that 'deal stage = offer accepted' was not listed as a re-enrollment criteria in the workflow. The criteria was added to fix the issue.
issues.workaround: For deals that cycled through Offer Accepted more than once during the impact window, manually enroll them in the workflow to ensure closing info collection tasks are generated.

issues.title: Automated emails displaying incorrect loan officer after LO change on deal
issues.desc: When a loan officer was updated on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the previous loan officer rather than the newly assigned one. The fix was implemented by the product team. The issue was identified on a specific deal where LO was changed from Paul to Julie Yocum.
issues.workaround: For deals where the LO was changed during the impact window, manually resend any automated emails referencing agent or LO information to ensure the correct LO is displayed.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs were receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks for deals that had already been marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow filters were not correctly excluding these deal stages from task generation. A tweak to the workflow filters was made to resolve the issue.
issues.workaround: For any deals marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window that received erroneous tasks, manually dismiss those tasks.

issues.title: MRC and TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not enrolling or triggering tasks
issues.desc: MRC deals updated to Offer Accepted were not enrolling into TC workflows, resulting in TCs receiving no tasks for these deals. The issue affected Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows for MRC and other TC-managed deals. HubSpot support was engaged and confirmed a fix was applied.
issues.workaround: For MRC deals that moved to Offer Accepted or Sale Pending between February 26 and April 1, manually enroll them in the relevant TC workflow to ensure all closing tasks are generated.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering tasks for referral accepted on March 18th
issues.desc: A post-referral workflow failed to generate any tasks after a referral was made and accepted on March 18th. The root cause was a data pulling error that prevented the workflow from filtering correctly, making it unable to enroll the deal. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: For referrals accepted during the impact window that did not receive post-referral tasks, manually enroll those deals in the post-referral workflow.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage before closing info submitted, missing credit amount
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was being sent when a deal entered the Offer Accepted stage, before closing information had been submitted and the credit amount could be calculated, resulting in the SMS going out with a missing dollar amount. The SMS is intended to trigger only at the Sale Pending stage. It was confirmed to be a dashboard-triggered communication and was escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: For buyers who received the incomplete credit SMS during the impact window, manually send a follow-up communication with the correct credit amount once closing information has been submitted.
